name: Cart drawer
description: A slide-over cart panel with a close button, line items, subtotal, free-shipping progress, and the view-cart and checkout actions.

name: Cart line item
description: One cart row: thumb, title, variant summary, quantity stepper, line total, remove, plus the saved-for-later variant.

name: Empty cart
description: The zero state with icon, headline, a line of copy, a browse CTA, and a recently-viewed suggestion row.

name: Cart page
description: The full two-column cart: editable line items on the left, a sticky order summary card on the right.

name: Discount code
description: A code field with an apply button in three states: idle, applied as a removable chip with the saving shown, and rejected with an inline error.

name: Free shipping progress
description: A progress bar counting a subtotal toward the free-shipping threshold, with its unlocked state.

name: Checkout stepper
description: A four-step progress indicator for cart, details, shipping and payment, with complete, current and upcoming states.

name: Contact and delivery form
description: Email, phone and a full Australian address block with a state select and four-digit postcode, showing the valid and invalid states.

name: Shipping method selector
description: Radio cards carrying method name, delivery window and price, including a free option, a selected state and a disabled one.

name: Payment section
description: A payment method radio group for card, PayPal and Afterpay, where the card fields reveal for the card option, with a security note.

name: Express checkout row
description: A row of express wallet buttons above the divider that hands off to the full checkout form.

name: Order review
description: The final confirm panel: every earlier step collapsed with edit links, the totals breakdown, terms consent, and the place-order button.

name: Order confirmation
description: The success state with order number, itemised recap, delivery address, estimated arrival, and next-step actions.

name: Order tracking
description: A vertical timeline from placed to delivered, carrying the tracking number and marking the parcel's current position.
